Authority boundary: physical page 1, folio 543-01. The printed folio and bottom page number are retained in coverage metadata rather than repeated in the diplomatic body.

Source replay: the Bourbaki header, November 1979 date, exact accented title COMPLÉMENT, attribution [d'après W. FULTON], and sole byline par Pierre DELIGNE were read from the authority pixels and frozen. W. Fulton is retained as attributed subject/source, not coauthor.

Printed spelling retained: the final sentence on the page reads « sécialisation » in the authority; it is preserved in the French layer and translated by sense in English.

Post-freeze comparison: the inherited candidate spells COMPLEMENT without the source accent and uses a modern reconstructed layout. No candidate bytes were accepted as authority.

Authority boundary: physical page 2, folio 543-02; the page ends mid-sentence after « en une démonstration ».

Source replay: the group-structure paragraph, Abhyankar-Fulton discussion, fiber-product notation, and Theorem 3 were checked against the authority image. Fulton and Hansen are credited only in the theorem attribution printed here.

Post-freeze comparison: the candidate was useful only as a locator. Its normalized mathematical typography was not substituted for the source reading.

Authority boundary: physical page 3, folio 543-03; the opening completes the sentence begun on page 2.

Source replay: the homotopy sequence is retained in the printed form ℤ → π₁(U*,u) → π₁(C,ū) → 1. The candidate's replacement of the initial ℤ by a fiber fundamental group was not adopted. Section 0 and all three terminology items are complete.

Authority boundary: physical page 4, folio 543-04; Conjecture 1.3 continues onto page 5.

Source replay: Assertion 1.1, the dual-projective incidence construction, and the parameterized isotopy argument were frozen from the scan. The printed sentence reads « Le cas i = 1 peut aussi se déduire de [6] ou [2 bis] »; the candidate's « de Lê » was rejected.

Printed spelling retained: the authority reads « Whithney » in the stratification sentence. The French and aligned English layers preserve that spelling; no silent emendation was made.

No page image fallback was required.

Authority boundary: physical page 5, folio 543-05; the proof of Lemma 1.4 continues onto page 6.

Source replay: φ(k), the inequality « dimension ≥ n* », and the commutative π₁ diagram were retained. The candidate changes φ(k) to g(k), changes the sphere inequality, and omits the printed commutative diagram; none of those changes was accepted.

The French page was frozen before the English translation was prepared.

Authority boundary: physical page 6, folio 543-06.

Source replay: the closures over f(Z) in the projection argument, the printed inequality n - c ≥ 0 inside the proof of Lemma 1.5, and the full density argument were checked from authority pixels.

P01 completion: pages 1-6 are complete in all three layers. Pages 7-10 remain untouched in the S01 predecessor state.

Authority boundary: physical page 7, folio 543-07; the compactification diagram begins on page 8.

Source replay: Theorem 1.6, the indexing (H_α)₀≤α≤m, closure bars, Lemma 1.7, and both neighborhood formulas were checked visually. The second formula includes the factor ε inf{|x_i|}.

Printed anomaly retained: the theorem's final target is printed as π₁(V,z). The candidate silently changes this to π₁(Z,z); the source reading is preserved without emendation.

Source replay: the exact sequence begins with ℤ, and item 2.3 is retained on page 9. The candidate omits the diagram, replaces ū, rewrites the exact sequence, and shifts 2.3 to page 10; those changes were not accepted.

Authority boundary: physical page 10, folio 543-10 and physical EOF.

Terminal matter: Bibliographie [1]-[9], including [2 bis] and the terminal « I » in item [1], the dated 1/10/80 postscript, sole-author signature, IHES address, and final page boundary were checked from the authority image.
